correctness.rationale: For a cell of an m-by-n colouring array, the edge-neighbour count is m+n-2. In any two-colouring equal-half forces R_i+C_j=2x_ij; differences make every row/column sum constant for m,n>=3, yielding contradiction. For m=2 parity gives exact 2/3 dichotomy. Colour i+j modulo3 satisfies the ceiling criterion except exactly (3,4),(4,4),(4,5),(4,7) for small m+n; explicit valid 4x4 and 4x7 matrices cover two, and modulo4 covers 3x4/4x5. The actual 1704-byte C++17 exception checker enumerates canonical colour/column-permuted first rows, lexicographically nondecreasing remaining rows, all 3-colour row words, with sound monotone count pruning; compiled and executed successfully for both finite obstructions, reporting no full assignment and 931 / 59228 partial extensions. This exhausts symmetry classes; no timeout or random test is used for nonexistence.
